title: Create app_color_schemes.dart
description: Create the Material 3 ColorScheme definitions at lib/ui/core/theme/app_color_schemes.dart. Top-level `const` (not class members) so the scheme is deeply immutable. Define `const ColorScheme lightColorScheme = ColorScheme(...)` and `const ColorScheme darkColorScheme = ColorScheme(...)`. acceptance_criteria: All Material 3 roles filled in both schemes: primary, onPrimary, primaryContainer, onPrimaryContainer, secondary, onSecondary, secondaryContainer, onSecondaryContainer, tertiary, onTertiary, tertiaryContainer, onTertiaryContainer, error, onError, errorContainer, onErrorContainer, surface, onSurface, surfaceContainerHighest, onSurfaceVariant, outline, outlineVariant, shadow, scrim, inverseSurface, onInverseSurface, inversePrimary
